name: Envious
description: After a devastating breakup, Vicky, almost 40, embarks on a quest for new love, unaware it will lead her to a profound—and hilarious—self-discovery.

videos.title: All About Vicky
videos.overview: Envious of seeing her friends in relationships as she enters a mid-life crisis, Vicky spirals out of control when she finds out her ex is married.

videos.title: Cosmic Kite
videos.overview: A girl's trip proves to be too much for Vicky when Débora reveals happy news. A text from Nicolás brings Vicky a much-needed escape as she turns 40.

videos.title: Like Machine
videos.overview: Despite an embarrassing allergy, Vicky is on a mission to find a date for her friend's wedding. What better way to find a plus one than a dating app?

videos.title: A Lioness but Not a Champion
videos.overview: Vicky finds a date for Meli's wedding, where a slip of the tongue causes the wedding party to crash to a halt. Matías' feelings for Vicky grow.

videos.title: The Game of Life
videos.overview: A trip with Vicky, Caro, and their mom, Tere, results in shocking news that changes everything. Débora begins planning her wedding.

videos.title: Pizza Delivery
videos.overview: Vicky's jealousy of Magui and Nico's friendship takes over. Matías struggles with his feelings for Vicky. Caro makes a life-changing decision.

videos.title: Everyone Gets Married Except You
videos.overview: Vicky's friends host an intervention regarding her envy and sabotage of others. Matías confronts his father. Daniel reaches out to Vicky.

videos.title: The Broken
videos.overview: When Vicky and Caro approach their mom about finding their dad, Héctor, Tere drops a bombshell. Vicky gets honest with Nicolás about her needs.

videos.title: Medical History
videos.overview: Caro discovers a devastating truth that causes her to spiral. Vicky's insecurity rears its head when she learns more about Nico.

videos.title: An Ugly, Comfortable Shoe
videos.overview: An intense therapy session brings out Vicky's competitive side. Débora gets cold feet on her wedding day, as Lucila and all the guests get a shock.

videos.title: Messy Woman
videos.overview: A successful agency party introduces new faces and a heartbreaking revelation for Vicky. Matías creates distance with Vicky after getting closer to Mei.

videos.title: The Little Mermaid
videos.overview: An injured Vicky receives help from a true friend and an impactful encounter with her father. Daniel and Matías compete for Vicky's attention.

videos.title: Head-On Collision
videos.overview: Vicky's dreams are close to coming true, but a panic attack causes her to reflect on what — and who — she really wants.

videos.title: When It Rains It Pours
videos.overview: Vicky rethinks her treatment of Matías after a confrontation with Nico stirs difficult emotions. Meanwhile, Caro has her ultrasound.

videos.title: Something's Missing
videos.overview: Matías' invitation leaves Vicky confused as she struggles to make sense of her conflicting feelings. Matías has a revelation about Mei.

videos.title: The Sect
videos.overview: A surprise encounter with Debbie turns Vicky and Daniel's romantic getaway upside down. Matías takes a step forward in his relationship with Mei.

videos.title: Flying High
videos.overview: Vicky tries to navigate the world as a single woman, but when she and Matías cross paths during a girls' night, buried emotions threaten to surface.

videos.title: Love Ninja
videos.overview: An awkward morning after with Matías leaves Vicky more confused than ever. A work assessment further sparks her insecurities.

videos.title: Leg or Thigh
videos.overview: A visit to Caro forces Vicky to confront her own setbacks. Matías tries to plan a surprise birthday party for Mei.

videos.title: Offside Romance
videos.overview: Vicky stands up for herself after Matías asks her for space. A hospital visit opens Vicky's eyes as Meli's new romance ignites a media blitz.

videos.title: A World of Coincidence
videos.overview: A conversation with Daniel leaves Vicky reeling as the consequences of her actions set in. Mei confronts Matías about his feelings for Vicky.

videos.title: Maternity Graduate
videos.overview: Matías attempts to be honest with Mei, while Vicky, Caro and friends have a curious meeting with a doula. The stress of the day catches up to Caro.

videos.title: A Perfect Breakfast
videos.overview: A major moment brings joy and panic. Matías and Mei have a heart-to-heart. As doubts loom over Vicky, can she let Matías in before it's too late?

videos.title: Planting the Flag
videos.overview: Exams, nightmares and therapy won't stop Vicky from immersing herself in her relationship with Matías... even if they aren't Instagram official.

videos.title: Tap Water
videos.overview: Vicky's jealousy of Matías' new job — and a new coworker — grows. Motherhood threatens to overwhelm Caro, and a job interview goes awry for Vicky.

videos.title: Robocop
videos.overview: A couple's dinner among Lola, Felipe, Matías and Vicky turns competitive. Caro's anxiety erupts as she confesses a deep secret to her friends.

videos.title: Out to Pasture
videos.overview: Vicky and Matías book a romantic getaway that quickly turns into a debacle. A therapy session ends in heartbreak, as Caro drops a bomb on Fermín.

videos.title: Booze, Country, Family
videos.overview: As Vicky searches for a new therapist, Caro keeps a secret from her. A night out with the girls boils over into an explosive fight between sisters.

videos.title: Female Gaze
videos.overview: Matías's work trip with Lola drives Vicky to distraction, as Lu struggles with her husband's infidelity. Caro tries to maintain everyone's sanity.

videos.title: Flipping the Bird
videos.overview: Arriving at La Cascadita, Vicky questions whether following Matías was the right choice. A phone call leaves Caro astounded at Vicky and Lu.

videos.title: Bad Mother
videos.overview: A new opportunity arises for Vicky as she babysits Emma. Caro and Fermín have a tough conversation. Vicky and Matías's relationship gets shaky.

videos.title: Losing Oil
videos.overview: Caro gets a terrible shock from Fermín. Vicky and Matías reunite, but is Vicky still on board with their plans for a future baby?

videos.title: Leaving Empty-Handed
videos.overview: An emergency session with Fernanda leads Vicky to a hard truth. A surprise visit for Matías leaves his future with Vicky hanging in the balance.

videos.title: A Mom on Hold
videos.overview: With Bruno now in the picture, Vicky finds that pleasing a 9-year-old boy is nearly impossible. Triggered by Nora, she makes an executive decision.

videos.title: Pack of Three
videos.overview: The reality of Bruno forces Vicky to confront a new fear. As she and Matías adapt to their new life together, another change is just around the corner.

videos.title: The Worst Customer
videos.overview: Teresa drops a bombshell, and Caro misses Fermín. Hellbent on landing a new client, Vicky's thrown for a loop when the most unexpected person arrives.

videos.title: Survival Guide
videos.overview: Vicky crashes Matías and Bruno's camping trip to mixed results. An important moment for her daughter sparks Lu's inner momager.

videos.title: The New Marcela
videos.overview: A pottery class turns into a reconnaissance mission for Vicky and Caro. An honest conversation breaks Caro's heart, and Vicky gathers difficult intel.

videos.title: Blended Family
videos.overview: Vicky's therapy session has a surprise guest. Wedding bells ring doubts for Vicky and Caro. Matías saves an impromptu wedding speech.

videos.title: Wake Up Call
videos.overview: A day with Nicolás puts Vicky in an awkward position, but a pre-school performance leads to a breakthrough. Caro and Fermín's feelings catch up to them.

videos.title: Journey to the Past
videos.overview: A dream unsettles Vicky right before an important, if questionable, work trip. Leni goes into labor, and a phone call sparks Vicky's insecurities.

videos.title: The Champions
videos.overview: Caro sets boundaries with Fermín. A bowling game turns into a win for Bruno and Vicky, but a moment of confidence threatens to set Vicky back.

videos.title: The Real Family
videos.overview: As Bruno prepares for an important exhibition, Vicky confronts the true pressures of motherhood, while Caro and Fermín turn a new chapter.
